page_title: FIO 1-1 JUV | Fiorentina v Juventus 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Luciano Spalletti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonathan David (Juventus) replacing Dusan Vlahovic.
88' Substitution. Kenan Yildiz will be replaced by Lois Openda (Juventus).
87' Having seen unsporting behavior, Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is the recipient.
84' Juan Cabal (Juventus) attempts to discuss the decision with Daniele Doveri, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
84' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is shown a yellow card by the referee for dissent.
82' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Luca Ranieri is replaced by Mattia Viti (Fiorentina).
81' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

81' Weston McKennie (Juventus) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
78' Juventus enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
76' A substitution has been made. Andrea Cambiaso is replaced by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus).

76' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
75' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
73' The ball is cleared after Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
69' Here is a change. Fabiano Parisi is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Eddy Kouadio (Fiorentina).
66' Substitution. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) did his best and is replaced by Fabio Miretti.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Filip Kostic (Juventus) trots off the pitch and is replaced by Juan Cabal.
64' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
62' Fiorentina get a corner.
60' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Roberto Piccoli and he is replaced by Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina).
60' Simon Sohm comes off the pitch to be replaced by Cher Ndour (Fiorentina).
59' The possession of the ball – 45:55.
56' Neat passing move from Fiorentina in order to create new attacking opportunities.
55' Filip Kostic (Juventus) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
53' Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' Fiorentina will take a corner kick.
52' The ball is out of play. Fiorentina win a corner kick.

48' 1 - 1 Well, this is definitely a candidate for the goal of the year. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) receives a precise pass and releases an excellent long-range howitzer of a strike, which finds its way into the net as it flies into the top right corner.
47' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

46' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. Now Fiorentina have a corner.
46' Paolo Vanoli has made a change at the break. Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) has come on in place of Dodo.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Doveri starts the second half.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+6' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Filip Kostic (Juventus) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of David de Gea, so the score changes to 0:1.
45+3' Juventus string together a series of short passes.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
44' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Weston McKennie (Juventus) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniele Doveri ignores the protests.
41' A pass by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
40' Great teamplay by Fiorentina as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
38' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
38' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina). The ball is out of play and Fiorentina manage to earn a corner.

34' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
33' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends an accurate short pass. Lloyd Kelly controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
29' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Moise Kean with a fine lofted pass.
28' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
27' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' Fiorentina control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
21' The resulting free kick from Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
20' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
18' Referee Daniele Doveri signals NO PENALTY for Juventus after a VAR review!
16' There's a break in play and referee Daniele Doveri must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Juventus using VAR. This could be interesting!
15' Fiorentina concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Juventus.
12' Fiorentina are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.

10' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
7' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) gets booked.
7' David de Gea (Fiorentina) and Luca Ranieri perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
6' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Juventus are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' Juventus are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Juventus will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Doveri.
